title: EMS System Configuration
description: Top-level system identity and battery topology configuration for the EMS. Defines site metadata and the physical layout of the BESS (clusters, racks, modules, cells).

_schema_version.description: Schema version for migration detection. Must match the schema's expected version.

site_id.description: Unique site identifier used in telemetry and cloud data. Example: RES-001, COM-042.

site_name.description: Human-readable site name for display in HMI and dashboards.

firmware_version.description: EMS firmware version string in semver format (e.g., 1.0.0).

model.description: Deployment scale tier. Determines default parameter sets and UI layout.

topology.description: Physical layout of the battery energy storage system. All fields are required to compute total capacity and validate CAN address ranges.

cluster_count.description: Number of independent battery clusters. Each cluster has its own BMU master.

racks_per_cluster.description: Number of BMU racks (slave units) per cluster.

modules_per_rack.description: Number of LMU battery modules per rack.

cells_per_module.description: Number of series-connected cells per battery module.

temps_per_module.description: Number of NTC temperature sensors per battery module.

subsystems.description: Declares which optional hardware subsystems are present at this site. Config_manager only loads device configs for declared subsystems.

has_dg.description: Whether a diesel generator is present at this site.

has_pv.description: Whether a solar PV inverter is present at this site.

has_btms.description: Whether a battery thermal management system is present.

has_meter.description: Whether an energy meter is present at this site.
